cases.name: let-name-misspelled
cases.description: <let nme="q"> — refused on the <let>, not on the <use> that finds nothing bound
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s"><sequence name="Q"><gen type="text" value="a|b|c"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><compute><let nme="q"><str v="hi"/></let><result><use name="q"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-lost-binding-blames-only-the-let
cases.description: two <use>s of a name whose <let> was misspelled: one error, on the <let>
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s"><sequence name="Q"><gen type="text" value="a|b|c"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><compute><let nme="q"><str v="hi"/></let><result><concat><use name="q"/><use name="q"/></concat></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-misspelling-inside-a-misspelled-slot-is-still-reported
cases.description: the pass reaches the parts the walk skips: TDC015 inside a <wen> beside its TDC180
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s"><sequence name="Q"><gen type="text" value="a|b|c"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><compute><result><choose><wen><test><equals><int val="1"/><int v="1"/></equals></test><then><str v="T"/></then></wen><otherwise><str v="F"/></otherwise></choose></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: an-unknown-tag-is-judged-as-a-tag-not-by-its-attributes
cases.description: <frobnicate foo="1"/> — TDC180 only; there is no list to hold foo= against
cases.config: <tdc><env count="1" seed="s"><sequence name="Q"><gen type="text" value="a|b|c"/></sequence><sequence name="X"><compute><result><frobnicate foo="1"/></result></compute></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{X}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-real-value-beside-a-misspelling-is-still-judged
